scope: Uncached baseline transcendental source compared with cached source using the same current Float80 implementation. This validates exact caching and sign-preserving power-of-two shifts; it is not a native-vendor equivalence claim or an overall FPS claim.

equivalence.operandCases: Deterministic full-mantissa extended values, signed zeros, tiny/large ratios, m80 subnormal/extreme exponents, and exact binary64-backed values; cold and warm evaluations.

cacheBound.validation: tests/transcendental-cache.test.js exercises eviction and proves both map sizes remain within their bound after more than 2,048 distinct inputs.

benchmarks.inputs: Fresh exact binary64-backed Float80 operands per call, same full mathematical implementation
